'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Michael Raveling LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Raveling]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet Michael Tiberius Raveling WHAP / Republic Troopers; Klor' Slug (V) on scan.

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Raveling]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
